name: SAVO
subtitle: Accident reports & your rights
promotional_text: Keep accident details together and understand your options after a crash. SAVO helps New Zealand drivers record incidents and navigate insurance claims.
description:
SAVO helps New Zealand drivers organise the details after a car accident and understand their options when dealing with insurance claims.

RECORD WHAT HAPPENED
Create an incident report with the date, location, vehicles involved, other-driver details and witnesses. Attach scene and damage photos, save your progress and keep your records together.

KEEP YOUR VEHICLE DETAILS HANDY
Store vehicle and insurance details, keep track of WOF and registration expiry dates, and access your saved incident reports.

UNDERSTAND YOUR OPTIONS
Read practical information about not-at-fault accidents, replacement vehicles, uninsured drivers and declined claims. Use the fault guide to explore common accident scenarios and factors that may affect responsibility.

FIND SUPPORT
Find panel beaters and tow operators, and follow links to Free 2 Drive to apply for a replacement vehicle when appropriate. Eligibility, availability and costs depend on your circumstances and the provider's terms; a replacement vehicle is not guaranteed.

SAVO is a consumer information and accident-recording resource, not a law firm or insurer. Information and fault guidance are general information, not legal advice, and do not determine legal liability or guarantee a claim outcome. Obtain advice for your circumstances when needed.

An account is required to save personal reports and vehicle details. Some features require an internet connection. Camera, photo and location access are requested when relevant to the features you use.
release_notes: Initial App Store release: accident reports, vehicle records and general insurance-rights information for New Zealand drivers.
